loglevel.description: Set the log level (default is error): none, info, warning, error, debug. Corresponds to -L/--loglevel.

logfile.description: Output to specified logfile instead of stdout. Corresponds to -l/--logfile.

config_path.description: Set the config directory location. Corresponds to -c/--config.

logrotate_enabled.description: Enable logfile rotation, with optional maximum logfile size, default: 2M. Logfile rotation count is 5. Corresponds to --logrotate[=max-size].

logrotate_max_size.description: Maximum logfile size when rotation enabled. Default '2M'. Used only if logrotate_enabled=true.

quiet.description: Sets the log level to none, same as -L none. Corresponds to -q/--quiet.

profile_enabled.description: Profile with cProfile. Outputs to stdout unless a filename is specified. Corresponds to --profile[=file].

profile_file.description: If set, write profile data to this file instead of stdout. Used only if profile_enabled=true.
